scope: Bounded existing-subscription comparison only under preregistered fixed slots/call limits. No API billing switch or extra writer/review/retry slots.

models.writer_availability_evidence: Independent authorized design-review call served claude-opus-5-5. Each writer operation must still record actual model and stop on mismatch.
models.critic_availability_evidence: Explicit requested model to be exercised in first budgeted pair question operation; no extra probe/fallback. Failure consumes operation and stops scope.
models.critic_served_model_limit: Installed Codex CLI may omit model metadata. Preserve model_actual=null; requested model plus unchanged explicit invocation/config and subscription route are the control, not proof of served identity. A reported mismatch stops execution; missing metadata is disclosed for all affected outcomes. This resolves the otherwise unobservable served-identity gate before outputs.
models.effort_requested: high for both CLI roles; actual effort unavailable and not inferred
models.manual_reviewers: Eight fresh fork_turns none built-in agents using inherited platform model/no override, plus one separate coder; actual model/effort metadata unknown.
models.preparation_sessions: One fresh neutral-reader question-setting session is separate from nine outcome review/coding sessions.

turn_metric_clarification.meaning: Installed CLI documentation describes maxTurns as API round-trips; inspected success-result counter increments on emitted user events. Preserve both observations, do not compare raw num_turns directly to requested max_turns or discard flags.
turn_metric_clarification.bounds: CLI max_turns requested; dollar and wall-time bounds remain primary resource controls. No canary retry or cap increase.

source_inventories: Actual staged q01 34 files/arm and q03 39 files/arm; exactly3 intended skill-file differences, no prior stories/reviews/eval documents.
execution_policy: Sequential eight slots in frozen order, --repeat1 --max-usd5 --no-critic. Preserve failures. No replacement or reroll. Driver reviews identity/isolation/resource metadata, not prose, between slots. Stop on model drift, leakage, unaccounted calls or technical faults. First-role failure does not authorize fallback.
raw_evidence_limit: Structured partial pair judgments/errors/cost retained by reviewed harness; invalid raw critic responses unavailable, explicitly disclosed.

critic_isolation_limit.codex_canary_meaning: The existing Codex canary passes its documented detection-based recipe even though repository/home/shared-temp reads may be possible. It does not establish filesystem denial.
critic_isolation_limit.critic_surface: Codex critic starts with temporary home/read-only workspace and masked prompt, but can potentially read outside supplied packet. Its adapter does not retain/scan full transcript, so external-read detection and fully verified context isolation cannot be claimed.
critic_isolation_limit.disposition: Accept before outputs as exploratory limitation; use explicit fixed-model masked questions/AB/BA contexts with no treatment labels or external-reading instruction. Report runtime critique separately from independent staged manual readings. Do not describe judge isolation as proven or interpret results as calibrated causal proof.
critic_isolation_limit.manual_surface: Built-in manual reviewers receive fresh contexts and progressive allowlisted packets; instruction-level blinding is recorded, not a filesystem enforcement claim.
